verdict.rationale: Canva ships an official MCP server explicitly designed so AI assistants can operate Canva via natural language — supporting design generation, editing, discovery, asset/brand management, export, and comments through NL commands, and this is corroborated by a probe confirming the documented endpoint. This directly satisfies the AI-native natural-language operation story, though it relies on third-party AI clients rather than a native in-product NL interface. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports of NL command reliability, and evidence of a first-party conversational interface within Canva itself.
